image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a disposable plastic lighter lying on its side on a white surface. The lighter has a translucent light-blue body with a black top assembly and a silver metal wind guard featuring an embossed pattern. A small, detached or melting-looking cube with green, red, and white segments sits near the nozzle area. There is faint, illegible text in the bottom left corner.
